content.title: How to Watch Pirates vs. Mets, Diamondbacks vs. Dodgers - MLB Opening Day on NBC & Peacock
content.text: We've finally arrived at the launch of the 2026 Major League Baseball season. It's time to celebrate Opening Day, and this season that means a pair of can't-miss games on NBC and Peacock. How to WatchWatch Sunday Night Baseball on NBC and Peacock.The action begins with the Pittsburgh Pirates and New York Mets on Thursday afternoon, and continues through the evening, when NBC Sports will host the only primetime game available on MLB Opening Day: the World Series champion Los Angeles Dodgers against the Arizona Diamondbacks.Before Opening Day 2026, let's preview the big league action that NBC and Peacock will bring you on March 26.RELATED: Pittsburgh Pirates Full MLB Schedule for the 2026 SeasonWho's playing in NBC's MLB Opening Day games?Opening Day begins early on NBC and Peacock with coverage of the very first MLB game of the day on Thursday, March 26. It all starts at 1 p.m. ET, when the Pittsburgh Pirates will face the New York Mets live from Citi Field in Queens.Thursday night, NBC and Peacock will roll out the red carpet with a special Thursday edition of NBC Sports' new Sunday Night Baseball show, featuring top broadcasting talent, marquee matchups, and more. Then, in the only primetime Opening Day game, we'll head to Dodger Stadium in Los Angeles, where the two-time defending World Series Champion Dodgers will host the Arizona Diamondbacks in an NL West matchup that marks the beginning of the Dodgers' potential threepeat campaign. That game begins at 8 p.m. on NBC and Peacock, with pregame coverage, including the Dodgers receiving their 2025 World Series rings.RELATED: Full MLB Sunday Night Baseball Schedule on NBC and PeacockWhat to expect from NBC's MLB Opening Day gamesPittsburgh Pirates vs. New York MetsThe Pirates enter this season with stars and potential, as Paul Skenes takes the mound as the team's starting pitcher and Konnor Griffin waits in the wings to put on offensive show. For the Pirates faithful, who've dealt with more than their fair share of disappointment over the last decade, it feels like this could be the start of something special, but it won't be easy.Right from the start, Pittsburgh will face a Mets squad hoping that veteran swagger and rising talent will help them finish strong in 2026, something that's been a bit of problem lately for the club. The Mets have home field advantage, so they're the favorites, but don't be surprised to see the Pirates do something special.Arizona Diamondbacks vs. Los Angeles Dodgers Then we come to the night game, where it feels like something of a coronation for the Dodgers. With tons of talent, including four-time MVP Shohei Ohtani and starting pitcher Yoshinobu Yamamoto, they're the team to beat not just in the NL West, but in all of baseball. They'll get their rings to start the season, while hoping to end the season with another piece of bling for their growing collection, but that doesn't mean it's all about the Dodgers.The Diamondbacks, led by right-hander Zac Gallen, are also contenders for the NL West, which means this could be a preview of the season endgame out West, if both teams can live up to high expectations.
